concepts.gloss_en: 'A woman who fears the Lord' (Prov 31:30) — read as malkhut/gevirta (the mistress), also the aspect of counsel (etza)

reason_for_human: All three occurrences are the identical scriptural phrase 'אִשָּׁה יִרְאַת ה'' (Prov 31:30), identically vocalized. Contexts consistently identify it with malkhut/gevirta (the mistress) at lm1:36 and with etza (counsel) at lm1:49 — the same textual figure across both lessons, so a single concept is correct.
